title: 第3章 三个月第4章 晋级二品
content_zh:
静。
大厅内一片死寂。
所有人瞪大着眼，满脸不可思议。
一品武魂？
天水城第一天才，竟然是一品武魂？
“哈哈哈！”
秦方也愣了下，指着秦浩狂笑道：“我果然猜的没错，秦浩，你这个废物，难怪三年时间，修为一直在淬体境一重，原来你是一品垃圾武魂！”
秦方激动的面色潮红。
过去他一直活在秦浩的阴影当中，几乎落下心理疾病，心中对秦浩的恨意也与日俱增，早就巴不得秦浩变成废物。
其他人恍然大悟，又是震惊，又是厌恶的看着秦浩。
难怪三年来，秦浩修为一直停滞在淬体境一重！
“一品武魂么，原来，你只是个废物……”
柳若雪喃喃着，目光复杂，只是这种复杂情绪顷刻间，便被冷漠取代。
武魂生而注定！
一品武魂，几乎注定不会有什么前途，跟她的四品水属性武魂，完全无法比。
赵元吉难掩失望之色，不再看秦浩一眼，淡淡道：“好了，本次武魂检测结束，柳若雪，还有什么需要交代的，你速速交代清楚，到了万象殿，就潜心修炼，不可分心。”
“是，长老。”
柳若雪行了一礼，平静来到秦浩面前。
“三年来，你的修为一直停滞不前，我就怀疑，你的武魂是否真的有传闻中那么高！”
柳若雪眼中闪过一抹厌恶，冷漠道，“没想到，原来你真的是个废物！”

秦浩原本脸上还挂着淡淡的笑容，然而听到这话，秦浩愣住了。
柳若雪从怀里掏出一枚晶莹剔透的玉佩，“这枚凤蓝玉佩，是我十岁那年生日，你送我的礼物，以前，我当做珍宝，现在看来，不需要了。”
说着，玉佩丢在秦浩面前。
咔嚓一声，玉佩应声而碎。
“这株发簪，是前年你送我的……”
“还有这柄木剑，用你的话说，剑由心生，心中有剑，才能施展出真正的剑法……你一个废物，真的懂剑吗？”
……
“现在，全部还给你！”
“从今天起，你我再无瓜葛，毕竟，现在的我是四品水属性武魂的天才，你高攀不起！”
看着面前呆愣的秦浩，柳若雪眼中闪过一抹不屑。
“雪儿，你什么意思，我们说好一辈子在一起，我们会一起进入万象殿……”
秦浩不可置信道。
“就凭你，一品武魂？”
柳若雪嗤笑一声，“秦浩，我希望你识相一点，你我的差距，犹如皎月与尘埃，我是高不可攀的皎月，而你，只是那卑微的尘埃，你和我，注定不是一个世界的人。”
“身为垃圾，就要有身为垃圾的觉悟，你这种废物，居然还妄想进入万象殿，可笑！”
垃圾！
废物！
秦浩只感到嗡嗡作响，两个字不断回响在秦浩脑海之中。
秦浩紧盯着柳若雪，道：“就因为我是一品武魂，所以你要和我断绝关系？”
秦浩胸口好似憋着一股火，就在刚才，秦浩还为柳若雪，向赵元吉推荐。

可万万没想到，柳若雪竟会毫不留情的背叛。
content_en:
quiet.
There was dead silence in the hall.
Everyone's eyes widened with disbelief on their faces.
A first-grade martial spirit?
The number one genius in Tianshui City is actually a first-grade martial spirit?
"Hahaha!"
Qin Fang was also stunned for a moment, pointed at Qin Hao and laughed wildly: "I guessed it right, Qin Hao, you are a waste, no wonder your cultivation has been at the first level of the Body Tempering Realm for three years, it turns out that you are a rubbish martial spirit!"
Qin Fang's face flushed with excitement.
In the past, he had been living in Qin Hao's shadow, almost suffering from mental illness, and his hatred for Qin Hao was growing day by day. He had long wished that Qin Hao would become a waste.
The others suddenly realized and looked at Qin Hao in shock and disgust.
No wonder Qin Hao’s cultivation has been stagnant at the first level of the Body Tempering Realm for the past three years!
"Is it a first-grade martial spirit? It turns out that you are just a waste..."
Liu Ruoxue murmured, her eyes complex, but this complex emotion was instantly replaced by indifference.
Martial spirits are born and destined!
A first-grade martial soul is almost destined to have no future, and it is completely incomparable to her fourth-grade water attribute martial soul.
Zhao Yuanji couldn't hide his disappointment. He stopped looking at Qin Hao and said calmly: "Okay, this martial soul test is over. Liu Ruoxue, if there is anything else that needs to be explained, please explain it clearly quickly. When you get to the Wanxiang Palace, you should concentrate on practicing without distraction."
"Yes, elder."
Liu Ruoxue bowed and calmly came to Qin Hao.
"In the past three years, your cultivation has been stagnant. I doubt whether your martial spirit is really as high as the rumors say!"
Liu Ruoxue's eyes flashed with disgust, and she said coldly, "I didn't expect that you are really a waste!"
Qin Hao originally had a faint smile on his face, but when he heard these words, Qin Hao was stunned.
Liu Ruoxue took out a crystal clear jade pendant from her arms, "This phoenix blue jade pendant was a gift you gave me on my tenth birthday. I used to treat it as a treasure, but now it seems that I don't need it anymore."
With that said, the jade pendant was thrown in front of Qin Hao.
There was a click, and the jade pendant shattered.
"This hairpin was given to me by you the year before last..."
"And this wooden sword. In your words, the sword is born from the heart. Only when there is a sword in the heart can you display the true swordsmanship... You are a loser, do you really understand swords?"
…
"Now, give it all back to you!"
"From today on, you and I have nothing to do with each other. After all, I am now a genius with a fourth-grade water-attribute martial spirit. You are beyond your reach!"
Looking at Qin Hao who was stunned in front of him, Liu Ruoxue's eyes flashed with disdain.
"Xue'er, what do you mean? We agreed to be together forever, and we will enter the Hall of Vientiane together..."
Qin Hao said in disbelief.
"Just you, a first-grade martial spirit?"
Liu Ruoxue sneered and said, "Qin Hao, I hope you know better. The gap between you and me is like the bright moon and dust. I am the unattainable bright moon, and you are just the humble dust. You and I are destined to not be in the same world."
"As trash, you must have the consciousness of being trash. It's ridiculous for a trash like you to still want to enter the Wanxiang Palace!"
Rubbish!
waste!
Qin Hao only felt a buzzing sound, and these two words kept echoing in Qin Hao's mind.
Qin Hao stared at Liu Ruoxue closely and said, "Just because I am a first-grade martial spirit, you want to sever ties with me?"
Qin Hao felt like he was holding a fire in his chest. Just now, Qin Hao recommended Liu Ruoxue to Zhao Yuanji.
But he never expected that Liu Ruoxue would betray her without mercy.
